question: What cosmic form does the wheel of Tripurasundari possess?
premises: The wheel has a specific form.
That form is the shape of the cosmos.
inference: The wheel of Tripurasundari has the form of the cosmic egg.
uncertainties: īśvari may be a vocative address or part of description; taken as vocative.
plain_english: O Goddess, the wheel of Tripurasundari has the form of the cosmic egg.
